standard.summary: 使用 alpha mask 对 loss 进行区域加权——只有 mask 覆盖的区域参与 loss 计算。让模型专注于学习特定区域（如人物、物体）。
standard.effect: masked_loss=True 时，每张图需要一个对应的 mask（图片的 alpha 通道或 *_mask.png sidecar 文件）。mask=1 的区域正常计算 loss，mask=0 的区域 loss 为 0。
standard.whenToUse: 训练数据有复杂背景且只想学习主体时。有手动标注的 mask 数据时。
standard.avoidWhen: 没有 mask 数据时（会报错，除非 strict_masked_loss=False 时回退到普通 loss）。

standard_en.summary: Weights the loss by region using an alpha mask -- only the area the mask covers takes part in the loss. It lets the model concentrate on learning a particular region (a person or an object, say).
standard_en.effect: With masked_loss=True every image needs a matching mask (the image's alpha channel or a *_mask.png sidecar file). Areas where mask=1 compute the loss as usual, and areas where mask=0 have zero loss.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the training data has a busy background and you only want to learn the subject. When you have hand-annotated mask data.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When there is no mask data (it errors out, unless strict_masked_loss=False falls back to the ordinary loss).

advanced.principle: loss_mask 被 resize 到 latent 空间分辨率，然后在 loss 计算时逐像素乘上 mask：loss = loss * mask / mask.mean()。alpha_mask=True 时自动从 PNG alpha 通道提取 mask。strict_masked_loss=True 时如果 batch 中任何样本缺少 mask 会抛出 RuntimeError。
advanced.intervention: training_step 中在 loss 计算后乘上 loss_mask。
advanced.expectedImpact: 在有精确 mask 的数据上可显著改善主体学习质量，减少背景干扰。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 concept_geometry_loss_weighting 可以叠加——区域 mask × 概念权重。

advanced_en.principle: loss_mask is resized to latent-space resolution, then multiplied pixel-wise into the loss: loss = loss * mask / mask.mean(). With alpha_mask=True, the mask is auto-extracted from the PNG alpha channel. With strict_masked_loss=True, any sample in the batch missing a mask raises RuntimeError.
advanced_en.intervention: In training_step, the loss is multiplied by loss_mask after computation.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: With precise masks, markedly improves subject learning quality and reduces background interference.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Stacks with concept_geometry_loss_weighting — region mask × concept weight.
